dut_ip_addrs.description: DUT IP list for fastboot installation.

dut_ip.description: IP address or CIDR range. Example: 192.168.1.100/24 or 192.168.1.135

scan_interval.description: Orchestrator scan interval in seconds. Default = 10 seconds

board_name.description: Board name of the project. This field will be removed once per model build is introduced. Example: brya

idle_timeout.description: The idle time limit for executing a fastboot command. Default = 300 seconds

broadcast_ping.description: Weather to use broadcast ping to search for devices under fastboot mode. When enable, the `dut_ip_addrs` will be ignored.

network_interfaces.description: The network interfaces that the broadcast ping is sent to search for devices under fastboot mode.

interface_name.description: The name of the network interface. Example: eth0

broadcast_address.description: The broadcast address of the network interface. Example: 192.168.1.255

clear_secure_storage.description: Clear secure storage and TPM in flashing process.
